playwrightLearning: For BC option fields on a card, the run needed real edit mode plus a visible field-value proof after reopen. The earlier wrong fallback clicked outside the edit pencil; screenshot QA corrected the edit coordinate. The field only counted after the visible GuV value appeared on the reopened card and chart. A repeat run may correctly report no setup write if the value is already persisted.
